title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced recording with clear Sennheiser 421 capture delivers a solid performance; both the show and sound are praised.
ai_review.review: The audience tape recorded with Gans' Sennheiser 421 microphones is described as crisp and comparable to the well‑known Stankiewicz and Wagner Nagra captures. Reviewers note that the concert itself is a good one, making the release enjoyable despite the lack of specific song highlights.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single 4‑star review; it positively rates both performance and audio quality with no noted drawbacks, leading to an overall four‑star assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear Sennheiser 421 mic capture praised; comparable to Stankiewicz tape and Wagner's Nagra 700, with no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; overall described as a good show.
